script_text: Pisces, this week's cosmic pressure could expose the price of keeping everyone happy. As a water sign ruled by Neptune, you’re reading relationships closely. Thursday favors clarifying exclusivity with the Sun in your solar 7th House. Friday’s Sagittarius quarter Moon squares that Sun from your 10th House, potentially pitting career demands against love. Saturday’s Moon enters Capricorn, your 11th House, shifting weekend attention toward friends, networks, and useful professional introductions. Monday brings the Moon’s conjunction with Pluto in your 12th House, favoring private preparation over workplace confrontation. Wednesday, the Sun enters your 8th House of shared money, approaching an opposition to Neptune: avoid assuming a partner’s promise guarantees payment. Wednesday is your power day for reviewing joint finances under that solar ingress. Friday is your toughest day because the quarter Moon highlights competing commitments. Request written repayment terms before any lending. Follow for daily updates.
